stem: Students created note cards comparing characteristics of eukaryotic and prokaryotic cells. Which set of note cards most accurately compares these cells?

options.label: F
options.text:
Eukaryotic Cells
• Membrane-bound nucleus or organelles
• DNA chromosomes in the nucleus

Prokaryotic Cells
• No nucleus or other membrane-bound organelles
• DNA chromosome in the cytoplasm
